selected_damping.reason: Foundation 11 isotropicDamping damps all velocity components toward the quiescent reference state, matching the G6 open-ocean numerical baseline.

timestep_disposition.foundation_11_behaviour: Foundation 11 performs pre-emptive adaptive timestep reduction from current/previous Courant information, with immediate reduction and damped timestep increase in the inspected VOF path.
timestep_disposition.rollback_retry: The adopted generic foamRun/incompressibleVoF interface does not expose exact rollback and re-solve of an already failed physical timestep.
timestep_disposition.diffusion: Momentum diffusion is assembled implicitly in the adopted stress-divergence implementation; an explicit diffusion-stability limit is diagnostic only for this baseline.
